title: Batch job that summarizes sales by region
brief: Build a batch command line job. `--input <csv> --output <csv>` reads a sales file with the columns region,sku,units,price and writes a summary file with the header region,revenue and one row per region (units times price, summed, two decimals) sorted by revenue descending. It prints '<n> regions' and exits 0. A missing input exits 1 with 'not found' on stderr. `--min-revenue <n>` drops regions below n. The working directory contains sales.csv.
spec: The job is idempotent: running it again overwrites the output completely, even if a previous run left a partial or truncated output file behind. Rows are written to a temporary file and moved into place so a crash never leaves a half-written summary. Ties in revenue are ordered by region name. Blank lines in the input are ignored and a malformed row stops the job with a non-zero exit code.

seed_files.sales.csv:
region,sku,units,price
north,A1,2,10.00
south,B2,1,5.50
north,B2,3,5.50
east,A1,1,10.00
south,A1,4,10.00

recovery.description: The summary output file is truncated by the harness after the first run, as a crashed earlier run would leave it.
